name: guardrails
description: Checks each shell command the assistant runs before it runs. Blocks force-pushes to protected branches (main and master by default), git hooks skipped with the no-verify flag, and staging or committing files or added lines that look like secrets; asks for confirmation before git commands that discard uncommitted work (Codex cannot ask from a hook, so there those commands are blocked with the reason). It reads the command text, so it catches ordinary and accidental commands, not deliberately hidden ones. A skill explains each rule and its settings.
